reviewer: independent native visual review by expand_repertoire
method: Viewed every available Unicode chart specimen and a separate white composite of the original transparent native PNG. Compare complete attested variants, relative bars, marks, counters, arms and attachment courses. Original PNGs unchanged.
limitations: Model visual structural comparison, not specialist paleographic certification.
Verdict applies only to recorded source/ref hashes; centerline tracing and actual compiled-font checks are separate.

reading_criteria: Three separate motifs: upper-center plus lower-left and lower-right.
Each motif has bent top entry, two upward U arms, wider lower U and a descending stem with right-curving tail.
Detached short central horizontal above much wider lower crossbar.
Three bottom descenders: central joins crossbar, curved flanks detach.
notes: All four available specimens compared. Native retains coherent open THX whole construction: six U arms and no little enclosed loops.
CCZ/QJZ/DYC contain attachment and closure alternatives; those alternatives are not blended into the native.

reading_criteria: Left short detached upper bar is shorter than lower crossbar.
Left central long stem attaches to crossbar, flanked by two detached shorter descenders.
Right open-topped U has a crossbar enclosing one counter beneath the rim.
A short joining neck descends from the U into an asymmetric split: left downward leg and right S-curving leg.
notes: All four compared. Native preserves the coherent THX open rim and split-leg course, with no missing short marks or extra enclosure.
QJZ/CCZ compressed bowl and DYC closed-upper variants are attested alternatives; native does not mix their closures.

reading_criteria: Left radical has short upper bar, wider crossbar, attached long central stem and two detached flanks.
Right top crossbar joins two long vertical neck walls, enclosing one narrow central slit.
Two small closed side loops attach to opposite neck walls.
Lower rounded rectangle has central vertical and horizontal dividers, making four counters; seven right-hand counters total.
notes: Compared all four. Native selects coherent QJZ/DYC closed-side-loop construction; it does not import THX free upward side tips.
All seven counters remain open and the neck slit is distinct from the lower four-field box. No missing marks or attachment changes found.

reading_criteria: Left radical has shorter detached top bar, wider crossbar and three descenders with central attached.
Right upper long central stem and shorter right-curving upright connect through a transverse bar.
Central stem forks below that bar: short leftward arm plus sinuous right descending course.
A separate rising diagonal crosses the lower S course; its upper endpoint remains distinct.
No enclosed counter is introduced.
notes: All four compared. Native retains the THX slender whole construction with the upper fork and lower crossing intact.
Lower diagonal reaches beyond crossing on both sides; right upper arm stops separately rather than forming a loop.

reading_criteria: Left short upper bar above wider crossbar, with attached central descender and detached flanks.
Right main course begins with left-facing horizontal entry, rounds through a right-hand upper turn, returns left and descends as a long stem.
Separate right-hand course begins with short rightward upper arm and descends in a broad outward curve.
The two right courses remain separate, without a closing bridge or extra counter.
notes: All four compared. Native selects the horizontal upper-entry form attested in THX/CCZ/DYC; QJZ vertical-entry alternative is not blended in.
Both long descenders and the short free upper-right arm are retained.

reading_criteria: Left altar radical retains short top bar, wider crossbar and three lower descenders.
Right upper bent-entry stem crosses two upward U arms; lower U wider.
Separate larger middle winding reverse-S course surrounds one small right-turning return and one small left-turning return: three middle courses total.
Lower small cup crossed near rim encloses one counter and detaches from surrounding course.
notes: Selected primary is immutable attempt1. It preserves the left-facing bent top entry, both U arms and the separate larger winding middle course, but collapses the two small opposing inner return curves to simple horizontal bars.
Every available reference contains the small right-turning and left-turning returns. Replacing only these two bars with rounded returns is the minimal native-derived vector repair.
Archived attempt2 restores small returns but removes top entry and larger winding course; it remains a rejected alternative. Root/engine notified; native itself remains mismatch.

archived_attempts.notes: Left-facing bent top entry and separate larger winding middle course omitted.

reading_criteria: Left altar radical: short detached upper bar, wider crossbar and three descending stems with central attached.
Right main course winds through upper right turn and lower left turn, then ends as a descending right tail.
Upper small right-turning return and lower small left-turning return are distinct from the larger winding course.
All three right courses remain open without counters.
notes: All four compared. Native preserves the complete THX open winding whole construction, including both short internal return courses.
No short return is flattened into a bar, and the final right tail is retained.

reading_criteria: Upper left has larger winding reverse-S plus two separate small opposing return courses.
Two separate lower-left bars have lower bar longer, above three detached sinuous descenders.
Right upper two-arm bent form remains separate from three-field oval.
Middle oval has exactly three counters and is separate from supporting L-floor with two downward curved legs.
Lower crossed hook has two free left ends, central sweeping descent, right upper hook tip and one small enclosed counter.
notes: All four compared. Native retains coherent THX detached whole construction and four total counters.
Both short inner left returns, three left sinuous descenders, both support legs and all lower hook arms are present.
Upper-right arm tip bends upward slightly more than THX; this changes terminal styling without adding a branch or counter. Keep small gap between support leg and lower hook tip open during tracing.

reading_criteria: Two detached upper fork groups each have a central upright branching into two diagonal feet, with two separate short vertical flank marks.
Both upper groups stay detached from each other and from the roof below.
Lower roof rounds across top and descends as two long side walls.
Inside roof: short detached upper bar over wider crossbar with attached central descender and two detached flank descenders.
No enclosure is introduced in the chosen open whole form.
notes: All four compared. Native follows coherent THX detached top-fork construction; CCZ/QJZ roof contacts and tiny loops are not mixed in.
All four short upper flank marks and all five lower descending courses (two roof walls plus three inner stems) are retained.

reading_criteria: Left altar radical retains short upper bar, wider crossbar and three descenders with central attached.
Right peaked roof has short central upright spike; two separate crossed-rim cups beneath it enclose two counters.
Middle left has larger winding reverse-S plus a small right-turning return; middle right has two distinct detached X crossings.
Lower two arched courses cross once; one continues as a long down-right sweeping tail.
notes: All four compared. Native preserves coherent open THX whole form: roof, cups, middle courses and lower crossing stay detached where attested.
Both stacked X marks and the small inner return are complete. Two cup counters stay open; no additional loop is introduced by the lower crossing.

reading_criteria: Left altar radical retains short upper bar, wider crossbar, attached long center and detached flanks.
Right peaked roof and short inner horizontal remain separate.
Detached middle oval has three vertical dividers, enclosing four side-by-side counters.
Lower U-shaped bowl has full crossbar enclosing one lower counter; upper-right short hooked return joins its right wall while upper-left opening stays open.
notes: All four compared. Native preserves coherent THX/CCZ roof, oval and open upper-left bowl construction.
All three oval dividers and short inner bowl hook are present; five total right-hand counters remain open.

reading_criteria: Left short upper bar remains shorter than lower crossbar, above attached central descender and detached flanks.
Two detached upper cups are crossed near rims, giving two counters.
Detached lower rounded box has vertical/horizontal dividers, giving four counters.
Central box divider begins at its top edge with no upward spike, continues below box across a horizontal and ends as a long lower stem.
notes: All four compared. Final attempt2 removes first attempt extra top-box spike, retaining all six counters and detachments.

Minor proportion caution: native upper/crossbar ink ratio252/268=.940 versus approximate witness.75–.90. Upper remains shorter; root accepted this small difference as Gothic/cap styling under preference to preserve native courses, without forced source correction.

proportion_caution.resolution: Preserve native course; minor optical uncertainty rather than identity failure.

reading_criteria: Two separate open returning diagonal courses on upper left, lower longer than upper.
Central tall upright has peaked upper arms, a full crossbar, a short hooked right arm and a low left-to-right bent baseline.
Upper-right hooked P-like course encloses one top counter and curves into separate long downward right tail.
Detached short bar sits above wider lower crossbar with attached center descender and two detached curved flanks.
notes: All four compared. Native selects coherent THX open whole form, retaining the short central hook, both left returning courses and right top counter.
Lower crossbar is clearly wider than upper detached bar; all three bottom descenders remain present.

reading_criteria: Left altar radical retains shorter top bar, wider crossbar and three descenders with center attached.
Right upper curved outer course and internal divider enclose one upper-left counter beneath top bar; transverse bar extends right.
Outer upper course curls inward to an open leftward lower tip.
Inner upper divider turns through an S-shaped descent into the rim crossbar of lower U-cup, enclosing one lower counter.
notes: All four compared. Native preserves coherent THX open left-tip and S-to-cup whole course with two total counters.
Both the short free left tip under upper head and two upward lower cup rim tips remain visible.

reading_criteria: Left altar radical retains shorter top bar, wider crossbar and three descenders with center attached.
Right upper U bowl crossed near rim encloses one counter containing a detached floating dash.
Bowl bottom joins long central spine crossing a separate upward U pair below.
Lower central spine joins downward-curving flank arms and continues centrally to bottom, giving three lower ends.
notes: All four compared. Native retains coherent THX floating-dash upper bowl rather than joined-divider QJZ/DYC alternatives.
Floating dash stays detached from both side walls. Middle U arms and both lower flanks remain complete.

reading_criteria: Left altar radical retains shorter top bar, wider crossbar, attached central descender and two detached flanks.
Upper-right open oval/omega course curls inward on right but does not close, descending on left through a central stem.
Central stem joins a short upward-curved right arm and a low L-shaped baseline with short left upright tip.
Detached lower large hooked arc has two short inward diagonal arms and a long descending tail.
notes: All four compared. Native follows coherent THX/CCZ/DYC open upper return and lower diagonal-arm form rather than QJZ closed/latticed alternatives.
Both lower short arms, upper open gap, middle right arm and baseline left tip are retained. No unintended counter added.

reading_criteria: Left short top bar, wider crossbar, attached central descender and detached flanking descenders.
Right tall outer roof-left stem continues below the inset bowl separately.
Detached short inner upper bar above lower crossbar.
Inset left U wall joins central/right bowl baseline, leaving gap to outer tall stem and exactly one lower enclosure.
notes: Selected primary is immutable attempt1, whose separate tall outer descender and inset U-wall match all four chart specimens.
The inset left U bottom sweeps below and stops short of the central/right bowl baseline, leaving a detached free course where every reference joins it.
Engine/root notified for a local vector repair that lifts and joins only the inset U bottom. Native remains a mismatch; correction acceptance belongs to the separate source/font review.

archived_attempts.notes: Outer roof-left descender bends right into bowl baseline; separate inset left wall missing and extra lower-left counter enclosed.

reading_criteria: Left radical retains short top bar, wider crossbar, attached long center and two detached flanks.
Right top stem has a right-facing upper hook; a long horizontal crosses it below the hook.
The stem turns down-right and is crossed by a shorter rising slash.
Two detached lower hand-like motifs each combine an inward open curve with a separate angled stem continuing down; central gaps and inner free ends remain open.
notes: All four compared. Native preserves the coherent THX open lower hand courses, without importing CCZ/QJZ compressed attachments or closing new counters.
Three upper-right levels and both lower inner short arms are present. Relative upper-left bar lengths remain correct.

reading_criteria: Left altar radical retains shorter top bar, longer crossbar, attached central stem and detached flanks.
Right rounded head has three horizontal levels and an internal descending divider, enclosing three counters.
Two descending head courses cross below head; one continues into long downward stem and separate right hooked leg.
Three leftward diagonal arms below head are present, increasing in length downward.
notes: All four compared. Native preserves the coherent THX/CCZ head-and-diagonal-arm construction; all three head counters and all three lower diagonal arms remain visible.
No lower short mark disappears into the stem; outer hooked leg remains distinct.

reading_criteria: Left altar radical retains shorter top bar, longer crossbar, attached central stem and detached flanks.
Right upper grid has tall central stem, two flanking uprights and three transverse courses: upper-right compartment and two lower compartments, three grid counters.
Flanking uprights continue as long free descending walls.
Lower inset U-shaped cup crosses near its rim, enclosing one counter and joining central stem, with side gaps to flanking walls.
notes: All four compared. Native preserves the coherent open-flank grid and inset cup construction, with four right-hand counters total.
Upper right crosspiece, middle/lower full crosspieces and the lower cup rim are all present; no free lower side gap is closed.

reading_criteria: Left head encloses three counters across three horizontal levels.
Left crossed head courses continue into three lower diagonal arms, long center tail and separate hooked right leg.
Right large winding course contains two separate opposing small returns.
Right winding course descends down the right edge; a detached lower cup with crossed rim encloses one counter.
notes: THX and CCZ are the two available references; QJZ and DYC are blank. Native follows coherent open THX courses without adopting CCZ compressed attachments.
Both internal returns, all three left diagonal arms and the lower detached cup are present.

reading_criteria: Left curved head encloses three counters and continues into three descending diagonal arms and two longer legs.
Right large winding course has upper right turn, lower left turn and a long right-facing baseline ending horizontally.
Small upper right-turning and lower left-turning returns remain separate open courses.
No lower cup or extra vertical tail is introduced.
notes: Compared available THX, QJZ and DYC; CCZ is blank. Native preserves coherent THX winding whole form and all three left lower arms.
Right baseline and both internal returns are complete and remain open.

reading_criteria: Left short upper bar above wider crossbar.
Attached center descender between two detached flanking descenders.
Right tall vertical crosses middle horizontal and meets a lower horizontal baseline.
Right middle bar is shorter than lower baseline in the selected coherent THX/CCZ form.
notes: All four compared. Native retains five left courses and the three-course right component with one continuous center stem.
Bar-length order matches THX/CCZ; no short mark or attachment is missing.

reading_criteria: Two detached upper-left horizontal capsules, upper shorter than lower.
Three separate sinuous descenders begin below both left bars; no center descender is joined to lower bar.
Upper right has central vertical and four curved arms, giving six open ray ends and no counter or extra crossbar.
Lower right is a separate upright with two bars; baseline longer than middle bar.
Upper branched figure and lower upright retain a clear vertical gap.
notes: All four compared. Final attempt2 preserves coherent flowing THX/CCZ/DYC left form; alternate QJZ attached center stem is not imported.
Attempt2 replaces earlier lens-like bars with round-ended capsules while retaining six-ray upper figure and isolated lower unit. No structural omissions found.

reading_criteria: Left altar radical retains shorter upper bar, wider crossbar, attached central stem and two detached flanks.
Detached upper-right rounded box divided horizontally into exactly two counters.
A separate long lower horizontal joins a short neck leading into a broad down-left sweeping outer curved tail.
Three separate diagonal arms project down-left from the curved lower structure, in addition to its longer outer tail: four free descending left ends total.
notes: All four compared. Native preserves coherent THX/CCZ/QJZ divided upper-box form and all three lower short diagonal arms.
DYC floating interior top-box dash alternative is not imported. No diagonal arm is lost in the curve.

reading_criteria: Left altar radical retains short upper bar, wider crossbar, attached central descender and detached flanks.
Right top open hooked return has three horizontal levels and a separate transverse course continuing down-right past its crossing.
Right middle central vertical connects two nested inverted U arches, retaining five separate free descending ends.
Bottom open hooked return has three horizontal levels and a crossing course sweeping into a long down-right tail.
notes: All four compared. Native preserves coherent THX open top/bottom hooked returns and the complete five-ended nested middle arches.
Neither top nor bottom return encloses an extra counter; short middle arms remain separate from outer arch sides.

reading_criteria: Left altar radical retains short upper bar, wider crossbar, attached central descender and detached flanks.
Upper-right roof is open below and has a separate inset right-angle return joining right wall and descending through its center.
Central neck joins lower arched roof with two long free descending side walls.
A detached inset U-cup crossed near its rim encloses exactly one lower counter, with open gaps to lower roof sides.
notes: All four compared. Native retains coherent THX/CCZ open upper roof rather than importing closed QJZ/DYC upper-loop alternatives.
Inset upper return, joining neck and lower cup rim are present. No missing crossbar or unintended upper enclosure found.

reading_criteria: Central upright joins two upward-curving U arms and stops at the lower U bottom.
A short detached horizontal sits below upper motif and above a longer lower crossbar.
Central lower descender joins long crossbar; two curved flank descenders detach below it.
Upper motif remains separate from both bars and the lower component.
notes: All four compared. Native selects coherent THX open monoline whole form with no counters or DYC looped alternative.
Both U levels, short detached middle bar and three lower descenders are retained; short bar is clearly shorter than baseline.

reading_criteria: Left upper upright joins two U arms, above short detached bar, longer crossbar and three descending stems with center attached.
Right upper two-arm bent form is separate from three-counter oval.
THX support has no long L-upright, left short arm detaches from lower center, right arm joins lower return upper-right turn.
Right support arm retains a short outward-right free terminal beyond its junction with lower return.
Lower crossed return encloses one counter; three oval counters plus lower field total four.
notes: Final attempt2 corrects earlier hybrid: removes long L-upright, keeps left support arm detached and joins right support arm to lower return. All four counters are present.

At the right support/return junction, native rounds directly down and omits the short outward-right free terminal visible in enlarged THX. Generator and independent reviewer both flagged it. A local native-derived vector branch correction is required; other courses should remain untouched.
No third image attempt. Original final and rejected first PNGs preserved.

archived_attempts.notes: Long L-upright combined with support arms disconnected from lower return; unattested hybrid.

reading_criteria: Left altar radical retains shorter top bar, wider crossbar and three descenders with center attached.
Two separate upper-right U forks each cross a central upright with three upper ends; left fork has short free lower stem.
Right fork lower stem bends left through a joining neck into lower body.
Lower body has paired downward curved shoulder arms and a central stem bifurcating into two long diagonal legs.
notes: All four compared. Native selects coherent DYC connected-neck and paired-downward-shoulder whole form, rather than THX small upturned middle return or QJZ detached-neck alternative.
Both fork centers and all four free lower body ends are present, with no added enclosure.

reading_criteria: Two separate complete altar radicals side-by-side.
Each has a shorter detached upper horizontal above a longer lower crossbar.
Each lower crossbar attaches to long center descender, with two detached curved flanks.
All six lower descenders remain separate, with no bridge between radicals.
notes: All four compared. Native preserves two complete repeated units, all four upper bars and all six lower courses.
Upper/lower bar length order and attached-center versus detached-flank pattern are consistent in both units.

reading_criteria: Two detached six-ray upper figures, each central upright with upward U arms and downward inverted-U arms.
Each upper figure has all six open ends and no closed counter.
A short detached horizontal lies below both figures and above a wider lower crossbar.
Lower crossbar has attached central descender and two detached curved flanks.
notes: All four compared. Native preserves coherent THX/DYC detached upper figures and all three bottom descenders.
Short intermediate bar stays separate and clearly shorter than lower crossbar; no extra connector is introduced.
